defect: The fix only adds the missing `override` specifier to FrameDumpTestScreen::ShowSearchControls to silence an inconsistent-missing-override warning.
reason: The method already matched the base virtual signature and overrode it, so the missing keyword was a compiler warning with no behavioural effect.

defect: The new stride-aware CheckAlpha loops for the 16-bit formats walk a u32 pointer but advance it by `stride` u32s per row although stride is in 16-bit pixels, so they skip every other row and read past the end of the buffer.
reason: The `p += stride` lines were added by this change and the fix halves exactly them; the u32 pointer and the (w+1)/2 per-row count are visible in the diff.

defect: The fix changes the loop index in RemoveQueuedEvents from int to size_t to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: The comparison works for any realistic queue size, so the fix is warning cleanup and does not repair a behavioural defect.

defect: The fix replaces `size_t num = -1` by an int and adds casts and a default case to silence type-comparison and switch warnings.
reason: `num == -1` on a size_t compares correctly after conversion, so the touched lines behaved correctly and the fix is warning cleanup.

defect: The fix disables the ARMv6 literal pool in MOVI2R, which the vertex decoder JIT never flushes, and restores the BIC/ORR sequences in ANDI2R/ORI2R for non-ARMv7 builds.
reason: The crashing literal-pool path in MOVI2R was already taken on ARMv6 before this change (bArmV7 was already a compile-time value), and the vertex decoder's ANDI2R/ORI2R constants are Operand2-encodable, so the dropped `|| !bArmV7` only changed code quality, not correctness.

defect: GameSettingsScreen::update calls MIPSComp::jit->ClearCache() whenever the debug-stats toggle changes, even when no game is running, and the stale jit left after exiting a game then crashes.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added call by the 'clear jit' message that checks PSP_IsInited(); seeing that the jit pointer survives game shutdown needs MIPS.cpp.

defect: The fix deletes the simplePipelineLayout_ member that this change declared but nothing uses.
reason: An unused member declaration causes no leak, crash or build failure; removing it is cleanup, and the leak and build fixes of that commit are in other files.

defect: The vendor check was changed from "Apple" to "Apple Inc." instead of adding the new string, so drivers that report "Apple" are no longer detected as GPU_VENDOR_APPLE.
reason: The fix restores the "Apple" alternative this change removed, and the replacement is visible in the diff.

defect: With host IO timing, __IoAsyncNotify keeps rescheduling itself until ioManager.HasResult() is true, but async operations that never queue a manager operation never get a result, so the notification is postponed forever.
reason: The fix adds the HasOperation() condition to exactly this new retry loop, and the diff itself shows __IoCompleteAsyncIO's comment that not all operations are deferred.

defect: The fix replaces the unbounded sprintf of the message in the Windows log macros by snprintf to avoid overflowing the 512-byte buffer.
reason: This change only renamed __ods__ to OutputDebugStringUTF8; the unbounded sprintf was already there before it.

defect: The fix turns the fatal FLOG on shader link failure into ELOG and adds an error-message return path.
reason: Link failure was already fatal (FLOG) before this change, which only added debug output, so the fix is a behaviour/API change for a pre-existing design.

defect: The ported BlitFramebuffer keeps unscaled coordinates (factor 1.0) when not using a hardware blit but now passes them to the new BlitUsingRaster, which normalises by the scaled framebuffer dimensions, so raster and copy fallbacks blit the wrong region at render scale above 1.
reason: The old GL fallback normalised by bufferWidth; this change's new raster path uses GetFramebufferDimensions, and the fix makes the factors always renderScaleFactor.

defect: DeleteData checks `param->fileName == NULL` on a fixed char array, which is never null, so an empty file name is not rejected and the save directory path is passed to RemoveFile.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added check by a first-character test; GetFileName's memcpy in the same diff shows fileName is an array.

defect: The SSE4.1 branch of Jit_ApplyFog calls GetGState() a second time into a shadowing gstateReg, so the gstate register is locked twice but unlocked once.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added inner declaration, and the duplicate call and shadowing are visible in the diff.

defect: CreateAVI passes the std::string discID through StringFromFormat's varargs for %s, which fails to compile on GCC/Clang and is undefined behaviour elsewhere.
reason: The fix adds .c_str() to exactly this added call; passing a std::string to %s is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix changes the YES/NO highlight rectangle colour from 0x20CFCFCF to 0x65636358 to match the real dialog.
reason: This is cosmetic colour tuning, and the colour before this change (0x6DCFCFCF) was already not the correct one, so no defect was introduced.

defect: The fix widens Abort's error condition from status == NONE to status != RUNNING.
reason: Before this change Abort accepted every status, so accepting INIT/FINISHED/SHUTDOWN was already wrong; this change only narrowed that pre-existing behaviour and the fix completes it.

defect: The new GameAchievementSummaryView::Draw calls RenderGameAchievementSummary with opacity 0.0f, so the summary background is drawn fully transparent.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added call to 1.0f (and the same pre-existing call in AchievementView); colorAlpha(background.color, opacity) in the new render function shows the effect in the diff.

defect: The fix replaces the blanket Qualcomm vendor check by a driver-version bug check, keeping the ARM case this change added.
reason: The Qualcomm-wide workaround predates this change, and narrowing it by driver version is a refinement, not a repair of this change's lines.

defect: The fix corrects the Mitchell-Netravali bicubic kernel and adds an SSE4.1 path; of this change's lines it only alters a debug log format.
reason: The bicubic code was added after this change, and the one touched line (SCALING_MEASURE_TIME log precision) is cosmetic.

defect: ExecuteOp's default case now logs currentList->pc, but ExecuteOp is also called without an active display list (e.g. when reapplying GPU state) while currentList is null, which crashes.
reason: The old dcontext.pc was a member that was always valid; the fix adds a null check to exactly this changed line, and seeing the list-less caller needs other code.

defect: The rewrite adds `using namespace KeyMap` without a terminating semicolon, so KeyMap.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix adds exactly the missing semicolon to this added line, which is visible in the diff.

defect: The pixel-size condition `fmt == GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888 || GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888_BGRA || ...` tests a nonzero constant and is always true, so every debug buffer is allocated with 4 bytes per pixel.
reason: The fix adds the missing `fmt ==` to exactly this changed condition, visible in the diff.

defect: The fix creates the D3D texture also when replaceImages is set but entry.texture is null (textures used as render targets) instead of calling LockRect on a null texture.
reason: Before this change the replaceImages branch already called entry.texture->LockRect without a null check, so the crash path predates the restructuring.

defect: The fix simplifies the empty-render-pass early-out, moves the scissor enable after the bind and uses GL_STENCIL_BUFFER_BIT in a clear test written by a later commit.
reason: In this file the fix adjusts work-in-progress code alongside a header redesign; the only line from this change it touches is the early-out condition, which is restructured with the render-pass actions rather than repaired.

defect: The new Symbian branch is guarded by `#elif defined(SYMBIAN)`, a macro that is never defined, so the Symbian CPU info is never set.
reason: The enclosing #if in the same diff uses __SYMBIAN32__, and the fix replaces exactly this added line with that macro.

defect: The fix switches the Windows Vulkan present mode back from FIFO_RELAXED to MAILBOX and restructures the instance flags.
reason: Choosing a present mode is a configuration preference, not a repair of a defect.

defect: The fix replaces the two printf lines (which print the float dp_xres/dp_yres with %i) by g_display.Print().
reason: The %i-with-float mismatch existed before this mechanical rename; the black-screen fix of that commit is elsewhere.

defect: The fix enlarges DECODED_VERTEX_BUFFER_SIZE from 48 to 64 bytes per vertex as a workaround for a crash in Pangya Fantasy Golf.
reason: This change only moved the constants from the GLES and DX9 transform pipelines with their existing values, so the undersized buffer predates it.

defect: The new decodeDXT5Block fills the interpolated alpha table in reverse order (lerp8(src, 6) for index 2 down to lerp8(src, 1) for index 7, same for the 6-value mode), so DXT5 alpha values are wrong.
reason: The fix reverses exactly these added lerp indices; the ordering can be checked against the DXT5 format from the diff.

defect: The fix redesigns the settings screen with an AnchorLayout so the back button is always visible.
reason: It is a layout redesign of a screen that was disabled work-in-progress in this change, not the repair of a defect in its lines.

defect: On Symbian, ReleaseView decommits at offset view - Base() without masking with 0x3FFFFFFF, although the views were committed at virtual_address & 0x3FFFFFFF, so shutdown decommits the wrong range and crashes.
reason: Both the masked Commit and the unmasked Decommit are added in this diff, and the fix adds the mask to exactly that Decommit line.

defect: The fix makes BlueToAlpha switch the cached framebuffer format to 4444 and dirty DIRTY_FRAMEBUF so it works with framebuffer reinterpretation.
reason: It adapts BlueToAlpha to reinterpret support added later, a feature interaction rather than a defect in this change's lines.

defect: The fix makes DecodeDXT1Block AND its alpha result across blocks instead of overwriting it, and simplifies DecodeDXTBlocks to return the alpha result directly.
reason: The regression lies in DecodeDXT1Block's `*alpha =` assignment in TextureDecoder.cpp, which this change did not touch; its own edits here only pass the local sums by pointer.

defect: The fix makes __cpuid delegate to __cpuidex(regs, leaf, 0) to repair the i386 inline-assembly cpuid path.
reason: The broken i386 asm block predates this change, which only wrapped it in an #ifdef ANDROID alternative that the fix does not repair.

defect: The fix adds a 'Game crashed' heading to the crash screen and moves the font-texture bind before it.
reason: This is a UI feature; the font bind added by this change worked and is only moved.

defect: The fix allocates the D3D11 upload buffers with 16-byte aligned memory instead of new u32[], which crashed the SIMD decoders on 32-bit builds.
reason: The upload buffer was already allocated with new u32[] (and decoded or scaled into) before this change, so the misalignment predates it.

defect: The added __AdjustBGMVolume calls scale numSamples * pFrame->channels samples, the input channel count, while swr_convert writes atracOutputChannels channels, so mono sources get only half the output scaled.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added arguments by atracOutputChannels, which the same diff already uses for the output byte count.

defect: The fix renames FRAMESKIPTYPE_0/1 to FRAMESKIPTYPE_COUNT/PRCNT.
reason: Renaming enum constants with unchanged values is a style change.

defect: The fix converts the Vulkan create-info structs to brace initialisation and zero-initialises blend0.
reason: The uninitialised blend0 fields predate this change, and the missing flags fields it left were set by intermediate commits, so in this file the fix is cleanup.
